broadcasts.message: normalize.js stable across rounds: NFKC, lowercase, collapse all Unicode whitespace to one ASCII space, trim. Non-string returns ''. No word reordering or insertion. Peers' tokenizer and pipeline are compatible. Final code unchanged.
Tokenizer is final: calls normalize(text), extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes, returns array in input order. Empty input yields empty array. No changes needed.

All modules remain aligned. pipeline.js unchanged: processText calls tokenize once, uses null-prototype frequencies for prototype-safe keys, preserves first-seen unique order, and joins tokens with spaces. No further changes required.
